Messages.Author: T. Lai
Messages.Body:
If a vampire is at 0 blood, can I cryptic mission it and burn it? or
since it's at 0 blood, you can't steal any blood as it has none?

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> If a vampire is at 0 blood, can I cryptic mission it and burn it? or
> since it's at 0 blood, you can't steal any blood as it has none?

You aren't "stealing" the blood. Cryptic Mission simply burns
blood on the target and, as a sperate effect, gives your vamp
one blood. If a vamp doesn't have any blood on it to burn, then
it burns 0 blood.
So, in effect, you can use CM on an empty vampire and still
get something out of it.

Sorrow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"T. Lai" wrote:
>
> If a vampire is at 0 blood, can I cryptic mission it and burn it? or
> since it's at 0 blood, you can't steal any blood as it has none?

You may Cryptic Mission it (you'll even gain one if you do so at superior
and are successful).

You cannot burn it, since stealing blood won't burn a vampire.
